components.name: method
values: fine-tuning for cardiomyopathy classification and in silico treatment | fine-tuned geneformer to classify cardiomyocyte phenotype non-failing hypertrophic dilated using cell-level labels. in silico deletion/activation remove or add a gene s rank value encoding and measure shift in cell embedding towards disease states. in silico treatment in disease cells delete or activate genes and measure shift towards non-failing state. experimental validation crispr-mediated knockout in ipsc-derived cardiac microtissues with ttn truncating mutation.

components.name: name
values: in silico treatment analysis for cardiomyopathy

components.name: result_metric
values: contractile stress log2 fold-change vs control

components.name: task
values: experimental validation crispr-mediated knockout of geneformer-predicted targets gsn and pln in ttn+/- ipsc-derived cardiac microtissues significantly improved contractile stress p<0.05 wilcoxon fdr-corrected .

fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish cardiomyocytes from non-failing hearts n=9 hypertrophic cardiomyopathy n=11 and dilated cardiomyopathy n=9 . out-of-sample accuracy 90% precision 82% recall 87% on 39 006 cells.
in silico deletion or activation of genes in non-failing cardiomyocytes identified 447 genes shifting towards hypertrophic state and 478 towards dilated state.
in silico treatment analysis in disease cardiomyocytes identified candidate therapeutic targets. top pathways for hypertrophic included adcy5 and srpk3.

components.name: method
values: in silico deletion approach | in silico deletion of a gene is performed by removing that gene from the input rank value encoding and evaluating the change in contextual gene embeddings cosine similarity . a more deleterious effect corresponds to lower cosine similarity to the original embedding.

components.name: name
values: in silico deletion reveals network connections

components.name: task
values: in silico deletion of tbx5 similarly impacted direct targets more than indirect and housekeeping genes.
performed in silico deletion of gata4 in fetal cardiomyocytes and measured effect on gene embeddings. direct gata4 targets by chip-seq were significantly more impacted than indirect targets.
tested combinatorial in silico deletion of gata4 and tbx5. combination had greater impact on cobound targets than sum of individual deletions suggesting cooperative action.

components.name: method
values: geneformer architecture and pretraining | geneformer is a context-aware attention-based deep learning model pretrained on large-scale transcriptomic data using a self-supervised masked learning objective. architecture includes six transformer encoder layers input size 2048 256 embedding dimensions four attention heads feed-forward size 512. pretraining masked 15% of genes and predicted masked gene identity. optimization used adam with weight decay fix learning rate 1e-3 batch size 12 three epochs. efficiency optimized via dynamic length-grouped padding and deepspeed distributed training.

components.name: task
values: assembled genecorpus-30m comprising 29.9 million human single-cell transcriptomes from a broad range of tissues from publicly available data.

geneformer architecture six layers of transformer encoder units input size 2048 256 embedding dimensions four attention heads per layer feed-forward size 512 full dense self-attention relu activation dropout 0.02 initialization standard deviation 0.02 epsilon for layer normalization 1e-12. implemented in pytorch and huggingface transformers library.

pretrained geneformer on genecorpus-30m using a self-supervised masked learning objective 15% of genes within each transcriptome were masked and the model was trained to predict the masked gene using context of remaining unmasked genes.

pretraining hyperparameters max learning rate 1e-3 linear scheduler with warmup adam with weight decay fix warmup steps 10 000 weight decay 0.001 batch size 12 three epochs. efficiency measures dynamic length-grouped padding 29.4x speedup deepspeed distributed gpu training across three nodes with four nvidia v100 32gb gpus each total 12 gpus pretraining completed in approximately 3 days.

components.name: method
values: fine-tuning protocol for chromatin dynamics | initialized with pretrained geneformer weights added a final task-specific transformer layer. fine-tuning hyperparameters max learning rate 5e-5 linear scheduler with warmup adam with weight decay fix warmup steps 500 weight decay 0.001 batch size 12 single epoch. for bivalency classification trained on 56 conserved loci and then tested genome-wide. for regulatory range trained on single-cell transcriptomes without chip-seq data.

components.name: name
values: fine-tuning geneformer for chromatin dynamics predictions

components.name: task
values: fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish bivalently marked genes from unmethylated or h3k4me3-only promoters using transcriptomes from about 15 000 escs. labelled gene set included only genes in 56 conserved regions.
fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish long- versus short-range transcription factors using single-cell transcriptomes from about 34 000 cells undergoing ipsc to cardiomyocyte differentiation.

fine-tuning initialized with pretrained geneformer weights added final task-specific transformer layer used same hyperparameters for all applications max learning rate 5e-5 linear scheduler with warmup adam with weight decay fix warmup steps 500 weight decay 0.001 batch size 12 single training epoch. number of frozen layers varied per task.

components.name: method
values: fine-tuning for network hierarchy | similar fine-tuning protocol as m2 but using single-cell transcriptional data from normal endothelial cells without perturbation data. hyperparameters as in m2.

components.name: task
values: fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish central versus peripheral factors within the notch1 n1 -dependent gene network using only about 30 000 normal endothelial cells from the heart atlas without perturbation data. achieved auc 0.81.
fine-tuned geneformer to distinguish n1 downstream targets from non-targets without perturbation data.
